solo_scope.SOLO-04: Foreign/revoked control, hidden input exclusion, unsupported action, conflicting work and atomic denied Rise build. Local blocked/depleted physical attempts retain their selected unsuccessful/elapsed rule, never a successful transfer

solo_scope.SOLO-07: Only committed handler outcome supplies narration; semantic intention/action agreement and character fidelity require human/model evaluation
solo_scope.SOLO-08: Not qualified: exact App/Catalog joined candidate and conditional live smoke remain separate

aip_evaluation_scope.qualification: Named integration checks cover portions of these requirements; original coordinator model cases and blinded semantic evaluation are not reported passed

dev_scope.DEV-06: Reuses actual handler observation; no general refinement of collection granularity
dev_scope.DEV-07: Current control/commitment/resource/stale and host-write conflicts tested; wider rejected branches remain open
dev_scope.DEV-08: One shared Core handler and host CAS; no new general simultaneous frontier/cross-scale qualification
dev_scope.DEV-09: One action identity and durable Core receipt; general phase scheduler remains open
dev_scope.DEV-10: Existing atomic local durations and bounded Rise work boundaries/reservations/completion exercised; no new general scheduler or interrupted process semantics
dev_scope.DEV-11: Bounded restart/replay and host-supplied branch/restore/CAS contract; actual App integration remains unqualified
